verdict.rationale: Clara documents creating virtual cards that are active immediately, and full card lifecycle control (create, update, lock/unlock, delete), so a finance lead can issue a dedicated virtual card per vendor. The Card Configurations API adds merchant-category restrictions and auto-deletion by end date, but category-level MCC controls are not the same as locking a card to one specific merchant. missing for 10: documented single-merchant/vendor locking, explicit SaaS-subscription or procurement card guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
